name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in Salta Province, northwestern Argentina. The project hosts Proven and Probable Mineral Reserves of 42.3 Mt grading 91 g/t Ag and 0.81 g/t Au, and a completed Pre-Feasibility Study demonstrates a US$494M after-tax NPV at a 26% IRR. In April 2026 the company received environmental approval from the Salta government, clearing the path toward a construction decision.
